acceptanceCriteria: The lifecycle stepper wraps onto additional rows instead of scrolling horizontally when it does not fit the panel width
lint, typecheck, unit tests, and the static export build all succeed with no regression
goal: All 9 lifecycle steps are visible at once in the Work Item panel with no horizontal scrolling required
intent: The 9-step Work Item lifecycle stepper (Attach through Close) overflows its panel width and currently requires horizontal scrolling to see later steps, per user screenshot feedback -- the user wants every step visible at once, either by shortening spacing or wrapping to multiple lines
outOfScope: No change to the panel's overall width/max-width or to which step is highlighted as active
